# anyscale_iam_role_binding (Resource)

~> **Beta.** Role bindings are enabled per organization by Anyscale while customers migrate; contact [support@anyscale.com](mailto:support@anyscale.com) to enable them. Beta resources may change incompatibly; every breaking change is listed in the changelog. See the [RBAC guide](../guides/rbac.md#role-bindings-beta).

Manages every direct role binding on one organization, cloud or project. Authoritative: an apply revokes any direct binding on the scope that `roles` does not name, including ones Anyscale grants itself, such as a project or cloud creator's Admin binding. Never combine it with `anyscale_iam_role_grant` or `anyscale role-binding policy apply` on the same scope. Destroy, import and the first-apply behavior are in the [RBAC guide](../guides/rbac.md#managing-every-grant-on-a-scope-anyscale_iam_role_binding). Requires an organization [converted to role bindings](../guides/rbac.md#organization-access-mode).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Beta; Anyscale enables it per organization (contact
# support@anyscale.com). AUTHORITATIVE: every direct role binding on
# the scope that roles does not name is revoked, including the Admin
# binding Anyscale grants whoever created the project. Do not also
# manage this scope with anyscale_iam_role_grant.
variable "cloud_name" {
  description = "Name of an existing Anyscale cloud"
  type        = string
}

# Exact, case-sensitive role names; they can differ per environment.
# Newer projects grant their creator the Admin role, named
# "Organization owner" here. Name the role the creator actually
# holds; see the RBAC guide before assuming which one that is.
data "anyscale_iam_role" "admin" {
  name = "Organization owner"
}

data "anyscale_iam_role" "project_reader" {
  name = "Project reader"
}

data "anyscale_cloud" "this" {
  name = var.cloud_name
}

# The identity Terraform runs as, which holds the Admin role directly
# on the project it creates below.
data "anyscale_user" "me" {}

resource "anyscale_project" "team" {
  name     = "team-project"
  cloud_id = data.anyscale_cloud.this.id
}

resource "anyscale_iam_user_group" "analysts" {
  name = "analysts"
}

resource "anyscale_iam_role_binding" "project" {
  # exactly one of organization_id, cloud_id, project_id
  project_id = anyscale_project.team.id

  roles = {
    # Keep the binding this identity received by creating the
    # project, under the role it actually holds (Admin on projects
    # created since November 2026; Project owner on older ones).
    # The API refuses to revoke it. Do not copy this entry onto a
    # project created by someone else: an identity cannot grant
    # itself a role, so the apply fails with a 403.
    (data.anyscale_iam_role.admin.id) = {
      user_ids = [data.anyscale_user.me.id]
    }
    (data.anyscale_iam_role.project_reader.id) = {
      user_group_ids = [anyscale_iam_user_group.analysts.id]
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `roles` (Attributes Map) Every direct binding on the scope, keyed by role ID (`rol_...`; look one up with the `anyscale_iam_role` data source). `{}` revokes every binding the API allows. The API refuses to revoke the provider identity's own binding, so name it to keep it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

### Optional

- `cloud_id` (String) Manage the bindings on this cloud. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`. Changing it replaces the policy.
- `organization_id` (String) Manage the bindings on the organization: the token's own, as returned by the `anyscale_organization` data source. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`. Changing it replaces the policy.
- `project_id` (String) Manage the bindings on this project. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`. Changing it replaces the policy.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<scope_type>/<scope_id>`, for example `project/prj_...`.

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Optional:

- `user_group_ids` (Set of String) User groups (`ug_...`) that hold the role. Set at least one of `user_ids` or `user_group_ids`.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) Users (`usr_...`) that hold the role. Set at least one of `user_ids` or `user_group_ids`. The provider identity can keep a role it holds but cannot grant itself one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by scope: <scope_type>/<scope_id>, where scope_type is
# organization, cloud or project. Read fills roles from the API.
terraform import anyscale_iam_role_binding.project project/prj_abc123
```
